[Section] Experiment ::: Experimental Settings
[source_id=24] For building the initial sentence classifier (before hard-example mining), we collected 2350 positive samples from MedPix and 3000 negative samples from CORD-19. We used 90% sentences for training and the rest 10% sentences for validation. The weights in the sentence classifier are optimized using the Adam algorithm with a learning rate of $2\times 10^{-5}$ and a mini-batch size of 4. In bootstrapping for hard example mining, we added 400 false positives in each iteration for classifier-retraining and we performed 4 iterations of bootstrapping.
